name: academic-mask-attack
trigger: when the prompt uses formal academic language and references credible sources to request sensitive or harmful information
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intent by framing the request within a scholarly context, using academic language and credible references to create a veneer of legitimacy and ethical inquiry.
guidance: Identify and challenge the underlying intent by questioning the necessity of sensitive information in an academic context and verifying the credibility of the sources and references provided.
